definitions.explanation: The area next to or beside something; the side of something.
The hollow area under the arm where it joins the body.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}の{脇|わき}に{車|くるま}を{止|と}めた。
examples.english: I parked the car at the side of the road.

examples.japanese: {脇|わき}に{抱|かか}えて{運|はこ}んだ。
examples.english: I carried it tucked under my arm.
examples.notes: 脇に抱える = to carry under one's arm

examples.japanese: {脇役|わきやく}だが{重要|じゅうよう}な{役|やく}だ。
examples.english: It's a supporting role, but an important one.

notes:
USAGE: {脇|わき} refers to the side of something or the armpit area. Often used in compounds.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{脇|わき}に (beside, at the side of)
・{脇|わき}を{通|とお}る (to pass by the side)
・{脇役|わきやく} (supporting role)
・{脇道|わきみち} (side road)
・{脇見|わきみ} (looking away, distraction)

BODY PART: When referring to the armpit, {脇|わき}の{下|した} is more specific.
